analysis_type: EXPLORATORY post-primary analysis (NOT pre-registered primary result)
context: Primary simulation revealed naive M5_REFINED (apnea hold + venous compensation + PI on ICP) FAILS pre-registered threshold with -14.5% reduction (WORSE than VIEshunt). This analysis tests whether smarter controller designs can rescue the M5_REFINED mechanism.

controllers_tested.vieshunt: PI on population ICP ref (12 mmHg), 30s avg, Kp=0.5 Ki=0.1, pump max 8 mL/min
controllers_tested.m5_naive: PI on patient-specific ref + venous compensation + apnea hold (drainage=CSF production during apnea)
controllers_tested.m5_bwave_tolerant: LOW-gain PI (Kp=0.05 Ki=0.02) + drainage capped at 1.5x CSF production + B-wave suppression (hold at production rate when venous elev >3 mmHg or apnea/post-apnea)
controllers_tested.m5_predictive: Drainage target = CSF production + 0.05*ICP_error, capped at 2x production, with suppression during apnea AND first 30s post-apnea (anti-backlash)

interpretation: See V2_HOSTILE_SIMULATION_ALTERNATIVE.json for full per-controller results and interpretation.
